Original Decipher card face for [[On The Payroll Of The Trade Federation|On The Payroll Of The Trade Federation]], as shown in the card list on Decipher's own website.

Source: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/images/onthepayrollofthetradefed.jpg onthepayrollofthetradefed.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020608034733/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/images/onthepayrollofthetradefed.jpg Internet Archive], 8 June 2002. SHA-256 of the archived file: 142aeafb74fc5b323bf8c80ff8135291f31790b81187dc5d134494d91ac0073b.

Edits: cropped to the black card border, and the corner pads outside the border set to white. The card face itself is unchanged.

The Holotable face used on the card page is [[:File:Cor-D-onthepayrollofthetradefederation.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
